text:
David Livingston shares updates on elections in Arizona, New Jersey, and Michigan
B. S. Martin
David Livingston, a Republican elected to the Arizona State House in 2023 representing the state's 28th House District, posted several updates on his social media account regarding election matters on July 21, 2026.
In his first post at 17:47 UTC, Livingston shared an update about the Arizona primary, stating, "Arizona Primary update https://t.co/19Z7t7UYzH".
Shortly after, at 17:48 UTC, he addressed concerns related to another state’s electoral process with the post, "New Jersey Election Fraud https://t.co/cTdwkACrW9".
Livingston continued with a third post at 17:48 UTC referencing Michigan, "Michigan https://t.co/b9Z3LB8WC7".
Livingston succeeded Kelli Butler as representative for Arizona's 28th House District following his election in 2023. His recent posts reflect ongoing public and political attention to election processes and integrity across multiple states.
